title: Embedded footage parallax
slide_intent: Explain spatial layers so movement through content has depth rather than becoming a flat slide.
strategic_value: The camera-and-plane relationship can connect Channel 4 programme footage to the world metaphor.
demonstration: A diagram places footage on several planes behind a wireframe room and camera; movement changes the overlap and view of the image planes.
practical_value: Plan the distance and movement of image planes relative to the camera.

content_islands.name: Layered footage
content_islands.spec: Arrange programme imagery on separated planes through the scene.

content_islands.name: Camera diagram
content_islands.spec: Overlay the white camera, view cone and room edges to explain the changing view.

reference_purposes.Application: The labeled Embedded footage parallax diagram explains a layered camera treatment.
